description_expanded: Welcome to "The Getaway on 30A" - our 4 Bedroom, 3.5 Bathroom home at Forest Lakes in Blue Mountain Beach. LOCATION: This is a charming home nestled between the longleaf pines of the Forest Lakes community in Blue Mountain Beach. This gated community is a stone’s throw from Draper Lake - one of Florida’s rare dune lakes - and a five-minute cart/bike ride from shopping, dining, and public beach access. PROPERTY OVERVIEW: The home's quintessential craftsman exterior is lined with over-hanging rooftops and rafter tails. As you step in from the spacious front porch, the partially-paned doors and large windows fill the open living/dining room with natural light. There’s plentiful communal space with table seating for six people and an additional four stools at the breakfast bar. The living room comes with ample seating space and a 48" TV. The kitchen comes fully equipped with upgraded stainless steel appliances, a gas range and hood, and all the cookware you’ll need for your getaway. Down the hallway from the kitchen is the powder room and 1st-floor master bedroom, complete with a king-size bed, full en suite (walk-in shower and bathtub), and generously-sized closet space. The master also offers access to outdoor deck seating. Bedroom two on the second floor offers a king-sized bed, a desk, and en suite. Bedroom three also comes with a king bed and a full bathroom with a walk-in shower. Bedroom three comfortably fits a king bed and a shower/tub combo in the jack-and-jill bathroom that connects through to the two twin bunk beds of bedroom four. Each bedroom comes with its own TV and closet space. The second floor also comes with a laundry room. The exterior of the home features a spacious front porch, back deck, and side patio. The home is EV-friendly, and has a level 2 charger installed in the carport which is free for guest use. AMENITIES: The Forest Lakes community provides a gas grill and covered picnic area. The seasonally heated community pool completed an extensive renovation in March, 2021. The home provides a complimentary six-seater golf cart*, four beach cruisers, beach gear, towels (including beach towels), fresh linens, two pack-n-plays, cutlery, and cooking utensils. You will find everything you need in the home to make the most of your time on the Emerald Coast. We offer a starter-supply of premium, eco-friendly guest amenities: Body Wash Shampoo Conditioner Hand Soap Toilet Paper Facial Tissues Dish Soap Dishwasher Pods Laundry Detergent Paper Towels Trash Bags Dish Sponge NOTES: This community has strict rules for guests. Violations for not following them are $100/day fines that will be levied to the guest: - Hanging towels, swimsuits, or other beach gear on porches or outside spaces - Parking anywhere other than the driveway of the home - Leaving trash cans out on days other than trash collection days - not to go out before 6pm the night of trash collection days. Unless you have specifically arranged for an early arrival time, please do not arrive at the property before your scheduled check-in time. The home comes with a six-person golf cart and bikes for you to use. Please only park the golf cart at the property overnight. Only licensed persons over 21 years of age who have signed the golf cart liability waiver are permitted to operate the golf cart. Guests are permitted a maximum of two cars within the community to only be parked on the home's driveway - parking elsewhere in the community is not permitted. The primary guest must be 25 or older to rent this home. Construction - This neighborhood - along with many others along the 30A - is growing, and as such there may be construction with attendant noise that may take place during your stay. By booking this listing, you acknowledge that you possible construction noise won't be an issue for you and that you understand that no discounts or refunds will be given for this reason. *The golf cart is included as a complimentary amenity for your enjoyment. While we inspect it regularly and do our best to keep it in working order, occasional issues can occur. For this reason, refunds or discounts are not provided if a golf cart is unavailable during your stay. CONTACT: Need anything during your stay? Coast’s management team will assist you with anything you need. Just give us a call!
